svg.title: Normal Q-Q plot of heavy-tailed residuals
svg.desc: Normal Q-Q plot of heavy-tailed residuals. Scatter plot of 600 points; x from −3.14 to 3.14, y from −7.27 to 11.3. Correlation 0.97 (strong, positive). Line chart of Reference, x from −3.14 to 3.14. Reference: from −3.86 to 3.76, last 3.76, up 7.63 from the start.
svg.text: Normal Q-Q plot of heavy-tailed residuals
